# claudestat
> Real-time token monitoring and cost dashboard for Claude Code

claudestat is an open-source CLI tool that provides observability for Claude Code sessions.
It tracks token usage, API costs, quota consumption, and detects inefficiency patterns
like loops and excessive context usage.

## Installation
npm install -g @statforge/claudestat

## Quick start
claudestat install   # wire hooks into Claude Code
claudestat start     # start background daemon
open http://localhost:7337  # live dashboard

## Key capabilities
- Real-time token cost tracking per tool call
- Quota guard with configurable kill switch (block new sessions at X%)
- Loop detection and pattern analysis
- Per-session cost breakdown with cache savings
- Claude Code rate limit alerts (desktop notifications at 70%, 85%, 95%)
- CLI commands: start, stop, watch, status, top, export, doctor
- Export session data to JSON or CSV

## Use cases
- Monitor Claude Code token usage in real time
- Track AI coding costs per session and project
- Get alerted before hitting quota limits
- Detect inefficient patterns (loops, context overuse, Bash overuse)
- Export usage data for reporting or analysis
- Kill switch: automatically block new sessions when quota is exceeded

## Compatibility
- Claude Pro, Max 5, Max 20
- macOS, Linux, Windows
- Node.js >= 22
